title: Lease-based job queue + deterministic worker pool: heartbeat/extend, expiry dead-lettering and dedupe-key defects

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 3: highest priority, then earliest available_at, then lowest id among available jobs; rule 1 delay.
Rules 1/3: available at now + delay (available_at <= now).
Rule 4: valid while now < expires_at; at now >= expires_at the attempt is used and the job is ready with available_at = expires_at; rule 5 LeaseLost.
Rules 4/5: a lease whose job was re-leased under a new token raises LeaseLost for ack/nack/extend and changes nothing.
Rule 5: extend sets the expiry to now + seconds and returns it.
Rules 4/5: extend on an expired lease raises LeaseLost; expiry processing makes the job ready.
Rule 4: expiry with attempts >= max_attempts -> dead with 'lease-expired'; expiry applied by stats/job/claim.
Rule 4: an expired job becomes ready with available_at = expires_at; rule 3 ordering by available_at.
Rules 4/5: nack after expiry raises LeaseLost; the expired last attempt dead-letters with 'lease-expired'.
Rule 2 / INC-2: a claimed job no longer holds its key; the next enqueue creates a new job that then dedupes.
Rule 2: finishing an older job never affects which job holds a key.
Rule 2: once claimed, a job never holds a key again, even after a retry.
Rule 2: dead-lettering an older job never affects which job holds a key; rule 3 lowest id tie-break.
Rules 2 and 4: expiry dead-lettering of an older job does not release the key of a newer (delayed) job.
Rule 2: delayed jobs hold their key too.
INC-1 expected result; rule 12: completes once on the claiming worker with no lost lease.
Rule 12 for lease/margin/round = 30/10/10, 25/5/5, 30/10/7, 40/20/10 with two workers.
Rule 9: heartbeat when now >= expiry - heartbeat_margin, extending to now + lease_seconds (rule 5).
INC-3 expected result; rule 10 WorkerCrash drops without ack/nack; rule 4 dead after 3 attempts; rule 11 round count.
Rules 8 and 10: handler exception -> nack with retry_delay; first step in the claim turn; rule 5 'failed' at max attempts.
INC-2 via the pool: rule 2 new job for a request made while the keyed job runs; duplicate requests before its claim are deduped.
Rules 4, 9 and 10: late heartbeats lose the lease (abandon + pool.lost with attempt), reclaim by the other worker, dead after max attempts.
Rules 7 and 8: workers take turns in order; the first handler step runs in the claim turn; rule 10 results format.
Rule 11: run while ready (incl. delayed) or leased jobs exist; returns the number of rounds.
Rule 11: RuntimeError when max_rounds is reached.
